decisions.reason: These underground mining dump trucks still fit the firm's specialized, safety-focused transport offering, although the earlier exit from mining loaders means the line would remain under strategic review.

The construction site dumper looks less differentiated than the firm's more specialized underground and lifting equipment, so management would likely reallocate resources to stronger core niches and new development.
The inclined furniture lift line matches the firm's lifting, reliability and service capabilities well and is the kind of niche product a German specialist machinery maker would usually continue.
The inclined building material lift line fits the firm's construction and material-handling focus and should benefit from its customization, safety and after-sales strengths.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift complements the lift portfolio, but its narrower application and higher complexity make it somewhat more vulnerable than the other lift products.
